title: Triage answers
description: What the triage routine posts on QuaX issues as quax-bot, passed to the Post answers workflow. Check a file with `node scripts/check.js < answers.json`.

issue.description: Number of the open QuaX issue to comment on. One answer per issue.

comment.description: Markdown posted as quax-bot. Labels and closing go in triage, never as a block in this text.

triage.description: Labels and closing for the issue, as defined by .github/triage/action.schema.json in QuaX. Appended to the comment as a quax-triage block, which QuaX applies.
